newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen signs oil deal with U.K.'s Dove.
newsitem.headline: Yemen signs oil deal with U.K.'s Dove.

text.p: Yemen has signed an oil exploration deal with the British company Dove, the state-run news agency SABA said on Monday.
Under the deal, signed on Sunday, Dove will look for oil in sector number 53 east of the governorates of Shabwa and Hadramut, it added.

The Yemeni government will contribute 25 percent to the project cost, starting at the begining of the explorations. Yemen usually reaches agreements to contribute to the projects only once oil has been found.
SABA did not give the exact cost of the project and Yemeni officials were not immediately available for comment.
Yemen is one of the poorest countries in the Arab world and is dependent on its oilfields, which produce 365,000 barrels of oil per day.
